The repair leaves nearly black fields and two newly arranged large pale block-like devices per panel. Do not turn these into dark black panels with a guessed pair of insignia, diamonds, leaves or named rank. Keep the actual source collar panel boundaries. Preserve actual glasses, smooth face, short combed hair, original grey garment, compact broad collar fit, photo/card opacity and genuine exterior transparency. No guessed branch or rank.
